blind.description: A cluster of five melted wax candles of varying heights fused together into a single dripping mound. Each candle stub has a concave top holding a small, vertical black wick. Thick, smooth, wax drips run down the sides and pool together along the ground into a continuous flat-bottomed puddle. Surfaces are smooth and continuous with a warm honey-amber or beeswax color; there are no active flames or glow.
blind.from_above: Resembles a cluster of five flower-like or coral-like circular tops with indented centers and black dot wicks, ringed by fluted drip edges and sitting on an irregular puddle of melted wax.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 8 to 10 inches tall and about 1 foot wide; reaches only to the lower ankle of the 5 ft 9 in figure.
